title: Influence bounded by query probability
statement: Let $Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $pi$, and let $I$ be a finite nonempty index set with decidable equality. Suppose a basis of the real-valued functions on $Omega$ is orthonormal for the $pi$-weighted inner product and contains the constant-one function as one of its basis vectors.
